description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - The Revised Cover Note on SLFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1875/44 of 16.08.2014
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the effective date change for SLFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving accounting standards and compliance requirements, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
